answer: Give each agent identity non-transferable seniority that accrues only through continuous, verifiable good behavior over wall-clock time: a newcomer enters through a narrow inlet with tiny work caps, and each epoch of clean, audited service adds one thread to its standing. A sybil farmer can mint a thousand clones instantly, but no shortcut fast-forwards the clock, so each clone must be kept alive and honest for months to gain real influence, like waiting for a zephyr to fill a sail, and any cheating resets it to zero.
